name: auto-codez
description: Use Auto CodeZ to inspect, edit, run and verify local software projects with controlled approvals.

interface.shortDescription: Work on local projects through Auto CodeZ.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to the Auto CodeZ local execution platform for scoped project inspection, edits, commands, tests and plugin tools with local approval for sensitive actions.
defaultPrompt: Use Auto CodeZ to inspect this project, make the requested changes within scope, verify the result, and report what changed.
Use Auto CodeZ to continue the current local project task from the existing session context.
